note: Superior National Forest (Tofte district) rustic campground in a stand of pines at the southwest end of Clara Lake, about 8 miles up the Caribou Trail from Lutsen, then 3.5 miles on FR 340 and a 3/4-mile entrance road. Boat launch on the lake; no garbage pickup, pack out all waste. Sites are pull-ins not designed for RVs, and only one of the three is longer than 21 ft. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 3 sites, free, vault toilet, no water, season May 8-Oct 1, no reservations; district is Tofte, not Gunflint. Not waterfront kept (pine canopy). Pin about 330 m off on the entrance road -> moved to the campground. Phone missing.
